title: Kakgold Recalls 4WD Remote-Controlled Car Toys Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys
hazard: The recalled remote-controlled cars violate the mandatory standard for toys because they contain button cell and lithium-ion batteries in the remote control that can be easily accessed by children, posing a deadly ingestion hazard to children. When button cell or coin batteries are swallowed, the ingested batteries can cause serious injuries, internal chemical burns and death
description: This recall involves the Kakgold 4WD stunt vehicles with a remote-control containing button cell and lithium-ion batteries. The toy car has a lime green and blue body, a black chassis and four black wheels with lime green trim and diagonal rollers. The vehicle body features checkered patterns, an “X” design and the words “PRO” and “RACING.” A white hang tag attached to the vehicle body displays “Do Not Twist the Shaft” in red lettering and illustrations marked with red crosses.
remedy:
Consumers should stop using the remote-controlled car toys immediately and contact Kakgold for information on how to receive a full refund. Consumers will be asked to write “RECALLED” on the product and email a photograph showing the product being properly disposed of in the trash to kakrecall@outlook.com.

Note: Button cell batteries are hazardous. Batteries should be disposed of or recycled by following local hazardous waste procedures.

title: Bose Recalls Lithium-Ion Battery Packs for S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ Bluetooth Speaker Systems Due to Risk of Injury from Fire and Overheating Hazards
hazard: The recalled lithium-ion battery packs can overheat and ignite, posing a risk of injury from fire and overheating hazards.
description: This recall involves lithium-ion rechargeable battery packs intended for use with Bose S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ Portable Bluetooth Speaker Systems. The serial number of the battery packs included in this recall begins with any one of the following six digits: 083723, 078352, 084105, 078591, 078592, 084106, or 086409.  The 17-digit serial number for the battery pack is printed on a label placed at the bottom of the battery pack. The affected battery packs were sold with S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ Portable Bluetooth Speaker Systems and sold separately as accessories or replacement parts.
remedy:
Consumers should remove the recalled battery packs installed in any S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ Portable Bluetooth Speaker Systems and stop using the battery packs immediately. Once the battery pack is removed, consumers may continue to use their S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ Portable Bluetooth Speakers while connected to AC power. Consumers will be asked to register and provide the affected battery pack’s serial number at www.support.bose.com/s1-battery-recall to receive a free replacement battery pack. For battery packs that are not installed in the speaker systems, consumers can simply view the serial number and provide that number to the website listed above. Consumers should dispose of the affected battery pack in accordance with local and state regulations. 

Note: Do not throw this recalled lithium-ion battery pack in the trash, the general recycling stream (e.g., street-level or curbside recycling bins), or used battery recycling boxes found at various retail and home improvement stores. Recalled lithium-ion batteries must be disposed of differently than other batteries because they present a greater risk of fire. Your municipal household hazardous waste (HHW) collection center may accept this recalled lithium-ion battery pack for disposal. Before taking your battery pack to a HHW collection center, contact that office ahead of time and ask whether it accepts recalled lithium-ion batteries. If it does not, contact your municipality for further guidance.

title: Huffy Recalls Buzz Bicycles Cerana T2 E-Trikes Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fall Hazard
hazard: The recalled tricycles’ rear wheels can become loose or separate from the rear frame, posing a risk of serious injury from a fall hazard.
description: This recall involves Buzz Bicycles Cerana T2 E-Trike, model E4004. The tricycle is a pedal assist tricycle. The tricycle is gray with "BUZZ" logos on the left and right side. The tricycle has a 500-Watt motor and a 48-Volt battery. The tricycle has three 24-inch wheels. The model number is printed on a label near the pedals on the bottom side of the frame’s downtube.
remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled tricycles immediately and contact Huffy for free replacement rear axle assemblies. The rear wheel axle assemblies will be sent directly to consumers or to a third-party who will repair the tricycle. Huffy Corporation will reimburse consumers up to $100 for charges incurred by the third-party repair.

title: Toys: Kidoo
hazard: Chemical. The toy's battery compartment opens easily without tools, making the batteries inside easily accessible. If a child puts them in the mouth, the batteries can overheat and release electrolyte which can be ingested by the child and cause damage to the gastrointestinal tract.
description: Brown horse with a mane and tail, made of rigid plastic, with its body frame covered in fabric. A battery compartment—housing two 1.5 V AA batteries—is located in the belly area. When the switch (inside the battery compartment) is turned on, the toy moves. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Toy Safety Directive nor with the European standard EN 71-1.

title: Toys: COOL.TRICYCLES/  Tricycle électrique pour garçons, jouets interactifs éducatifs et créatifs
hazard: Chemical. The screw that secures the battery compartment is not captive. If the screw is lost when the batteries are being changed, the cover of the battery compartment could be removed easily. If a child puts them in the mouth, the batteries can overheat and release electrolyte which can be ingested by the child and cause damage to the gastrointestinal tract.
description: Character toy electric tricycle, battery operated, with LEDs on wheels and on the propeller. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Toy Safety Directive nor with European standards EN 62115 and EN 71-1.
remedy: Removal From Online Marketplace; Warning Consumers Of Risks

title: Communication Media: Portable Bluetooth Speaker
hazard: Fire, Injuries. The lithium-ion battery may overheat during normal use and enter thermal runaway. This may result in smoke, ejection of battery material and fire.
description: Portable rechargeable Bluetooth speaker powered by an internal lithium-ion battery pack, in dark grey, light grey and blue colours. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Radio Equipment Directive.
remedy: Product Recall From Consumers; Warning Consumers Of Risks
country: United Kingdom in respect of Northern Ireland

title: Electrical Appliances: DM132
hazard: Electric_Shock. The windings in the transformer are not properly fixed or insulated and are too close to the metal parts. Additionally, the safety distances on the printed circuit board are too small and the distance between the live parts and the appliance’s outer casing is insufficient. As a result, accessible parts could become live, increasing the risk of electric shock.
description: White USB wall charger The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive.

title: Electrical Appliances: Chargeur Rapide 20W avec Port USB
hazard: Electric_Shock. The product lacks adequate insulation between the primary and secondary circuits. The secondary USB ports and the connected cable can become live under mains voltage. Consequently, the user may receive an electric shock.
description: USB charger with: Input voltage: 100-240 V AC Output: 5 V DC / 9 V DC / 12 V DC Power or current output: 3 A / 2.22 A / 1.67 A Class II protection against electric shocks. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive.

title: Electrical Appliances: Fast Charger with 15 W Power
hazard: Electric_Shock. The creepage distance between the primary and secondary circuit are inadequate. Live parts of the product may become accessible to the user who can receive an electric shock.
description: USB charger. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive nor with the European standard EN 62368-1.
remedy: Product Recall From Consumers; Product Withdrawal From Market

title: Electrical Appliances: Girlanda
hazard: Electric_Shock. The live parts of the lamp cap are accessible when the lamp is partially screwed into the lampholder of the luminaire, leading to electric shock. Consequently, the user could touch accessible live parts and receive an electric shock.
description: LED-lighting chain. AC Mains pluggable with non-detachable power supply cord, class II, 16 A round plug. E27 lamp holders. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive and the relevant European standard EN IEC 60598.
